name: YYDS
fix_description: Replace the spot price calculation in getPriceOfUSDT (reading pair balanceOf directly) with a TWAP oracle or Chainlink price feed that cannot be manipulated within a single transaction by flash loans.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a short, direct flash-swap exploit with only a few protocol calls: borrow USDT, invoke claim plus three withdraw functions, then repay using a simple pair calculation. It does not require deep protocol internals, complex multi-protocol routing, or a long attack chain, so an experienced auditor could likely reproduce it quickly.
